3240-3899-6462-8347.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Sela triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2105-4742-7431-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-4742-7431-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-4742-7431-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Daydream from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Daydream from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

116-5107-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Rally of Wings is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Kiora's Follower doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
116-5107-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Rally of Wings without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Rally of Wings, untapping all creatures you control and giving creatures you control that have flying +2/+2 until end of turn
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

856-1379-6748-6757-8095.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

2921-4153-4186--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 5.

560-2921-4550-7920.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-2921-4550-7920.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Tresserhorn's Lord triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Bartolomé del Presidio abilities.
Repeat.

553-2093-5858.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Gandalf.
In response, cast Lapse of Certainty by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

1887-3099-3921-4762.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Winding Constrictor and Vorinclex.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1849-3259-7605.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-3259-7605.description:
Cast Indulge by paying {2}{R}.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker. Indulge triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
1849-3259-7605.notes: Afterwards, you can cast Excess from your graveyard for {1}{R} to create Treasures.

1558-2557-3756-3875-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2557-3756-3875-4231.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Parallel Lives.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

698-6867-7042.notablePrerequisites: You've gained 2 or more life this turn.
698-6867-7042.description:
Activate Will by tapping it.
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 3.

1734-2511-4681.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

4871-5220-5447-6797.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
You have solved Case of the Locked Hothouse.
4871-5220-5447-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

104-4050-4094-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites:
Kaya has two or more loyalty counters on it.
Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-4050-4094-5086-5183.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

1510-2829-4574-5849.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Arcbound Stinger.
When Arcbound Stinger dies, its modular ability triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Arcbound Stinger from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Arcbound Stinger from the top of your library by paying {0} due to Fortune Teller's Talent.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-4288-5226.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-4288-5226.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Sarinth Greatwurm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Lithatog ability
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

969-1170-1329-4211.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard.
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2082-3197-6798.easyPrerequisites: Sadistic Glee attached to Herd Baloth.
2082-3197-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2082-3197-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies, Sadisitc Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2511-3719-6188-6307--85.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five creatures, excluding Fear of Missing Out, that have total power 1 or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill Fear of Missing Out or Luxurious Locomotive.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
2511-3719-6188-6307--85.description:
Activate Luxurious Locomotive's crew ability by tapping five creatures you control with total power 1 or greater, causing Luxurious Locomotive to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Luxurious Locomotive and Fear of Missing Out as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Luxurious Locomotive trigger, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out trigger, untapping Luxurious Locomotive and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Fear of Missing Out.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing two Treasures, returning Fear of Missing Out from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fear of Missing Out enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

224-1772-3257-3470.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Lotus Cobra trigger
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

1479-1817-5621.description:
Cast Kodama of the East Tree by paying {4}{G}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, copying the Kodama of the East Tree spell.
Resolve both Kodama of the East Tree spells, with the copy creating a nonlegendary token copy of Kodama of the East Tree.
Play Arid Archway.
Kodama of the East Tree, the Kodama of the East Tree token, and Arid Archway trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree token's trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Arid Archway onto the battlefield.
The Kodama of the East Tree token and Arid Archway trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree token's trigger, putting Arid Archway onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Arid Archway trigger.
Repeat from step 8.

204-2450-5851.manaNeeded: {5} at most, depending on how many Stormsplitters and/or other creatures you control without summoning sickness
204-2450-5851.notablePrerequisites: Sorcerer Class is at least level 2.
204-2450-5851.description:
Activate any creature you control that does not have summoning sickness by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat step 1 until you control no untapped creatures without summoning sickness, or until you have {2}{U} available, whichever comes first.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}.
Each Stormsplitter you control triggers, and Sorcerer Class's third ability triggers if it is level 3.
Resolve the Stormsplitter triggers, creating that many token copies of Stormsplitter.
Resolve the Sorcerer Class trigger, if applicable, dealing damage to any target equal to the number of instant and/or sorcery spells you've cast this turn.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

803-3057-5703.notablePrerequisites:
"Assassin" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have a way to give Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad vigilance.
803-3057-5703.description:
Give Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad vigilance by any method.
Declare Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad as an attacker.
Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, exiling Bloodthirster from your graveyard with a memory counter on it as it is an Assassin due to Arcane Adaptation, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each creature you own in exile with a memory counter on it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the Bloodthirster token.
The Bloodthirster token triggers, causing you to untap it and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, exiling the Bloodthirster token.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad as an attacker.
Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each creature you own in exile with a memory counter on it.
Repeat from step 4.

390-1558-3529-4231.notablePrerequisites:
Hulking Metamorph is a copy of Academy Manufactor.
Hoard Robber does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by at least one opponent.
390-1558-3529-4231.description:
Attack with Hoard Robber.
Hoard Robber triggers on combat damage to a player, creating three Treasure tokens, three Food tokens, and three Clue tokens.
Activate Time Sieve's ability by tapping Time Sieve and sacrificing five artifacts you control, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-5147-5551.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
1270-5147-5551.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Taq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Taq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 4.

1737-2119-2544-5149.notablePrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Filigree Sages.
1737-2119-2544-5149.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Seat of the Synod.
Activate the Seat of the Synod token by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {U}, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

1365-3723-3944-5112-5295.notablePrerequisites: Mairsil does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-3723-3944-5112-5295.description:
Activate Mairsil using Cauldron of Souls' ability by tapping it, giving itself persist until end of turn.
Activate Mairsil using Blood Pet's ability by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Mairsil dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Mairsil using Carnifex Demon's ability by paying {B} and removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on each other creature.
Repeat.

863-3496-5269.description:
Cast Atzocan Archer by paying {2}{G}.
Atzocan Archer enters the battlefield, fighting Dread Slaver.
Atzocan Archer dies, triggering Dread Slaver, returning Atzocan Archer to the battlefield as a black Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2.

215-380-2743-4875.description:
Cast Biovisionary by paying {1}{G}{U}.
When Biovisionary enters the battlefield, Miirym triggers, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Biovisionary to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat from step 1 one additional time.
Cast Biovisionary by paying {1}{G}{U}.
When Biovisionary enters the battlefield, Miirym triggers, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

1885-2493-2639-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Mitotic Slime and Archaeomancer, adding {W}{W}.
When Mitotic Slime dies, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Oozes, adding {G}{G}.
When the Oozes die, they trigger, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Oozes, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Eerie Ultimatum by paying {W}{W}{B}{B}{B}{G}{G}, returning Archaeomancer and Mitotic Slime to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Eerie Ultimatum from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

678-2452-3882.description:
Cast Silumgar Scavenger by paying {0}.
When Silumgar Scavenger enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Silumgar Scavenger dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning it to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

500-2047-2557-3129.notablePrerequisites: You control a nonlegendary artifact creature that does not have Mechanized Production attached.
500-2047-2557-3129.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers.
Holding priority, cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying a nonlegendary artifact creature you control and creating eight token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Resolve the Mechanized Production trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to, and causing you to win the game.

1479-2232-3605.notablePrerequisites: You have a nonartifact enchantment creature in your graveyard with a mana value of two or greater.
1479-2232-3605.description:
Cast Dance of the Dead by paying {1}{B}.
Dance of the Dead enters the battlefield, triggering itself, Kodama, and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Dance of the Dead trigger, returning a nonartifact enchantment creature with mana value two or greater from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
The enchantment creature enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger from the enchantment creature, returning Dance of the Dead from the battlefield to your hand.
Dance of the Dead leaves the battlefield, causing you to sacrifice the creature it was attached to.
Resolve the Kodama trigger from the enchantment creature, putting Dance of the Dead from your hand onto the battlefield.
Dance of the Dead enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Repeat from step 3.

2228-2744-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Devoted Druid does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2228-2744-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Hapatra triggers, creating a 1/1 Snake creature token.
The Snake enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.
